text_block_list.text: I spot Эйр Грув looking a bit down.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Ugh. Why didn't I notice it sooner?
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: Yes... I made quite the fool of myself.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
The president kept saying things like
"That's the
last straw" and "I'm clutching
at straws" during
lunch today.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
I knew she must have been driving at a
pun of
some kind, but I couldn't figure
out what it was
for the life of me.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: But I just realized—I was drinking sparkling water with a straw the entire time!
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
The answer was right there in front of
me! Ugh...
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
I try to cheer her up, despite her...
unique reason
for being upset.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
